title: The Hard Cover
author: M. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Elodie Montrose, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
